output_list.criticism: The quaker function does not check if the wallet parameter is the zero address. This could lead to potential security issues, such as allowing the contract to be owned by the zero address.
The mint function is currently only callable by the contract owner. This means that anyone can mint tokens, which could lead to potential security issues.
The pullBack function is currently only callable by the contract owner. This means that anyone can pull back tokens, which could lead to potential security issues.
The showMyTokenBalance function is currently public, which means that anyone can view the token balance of any address. This could lead to potential security issues.
